Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 20, Ultimate Combat pg. 134
StatisticsDamage 1d4 (small), 1d6 (medium); Critical 18-20/x2; Range -; Type P or S
Weapon Groups Blades, Light
DescriptionThese short, slender blades are between 1 to 2 feet long. They are primarily used as back-up weapons, to decapitate defeated enemies, or to commit seppuku (ritual suicide) as a matter of honor.
